props.name: aria-label
props.description: Provide an optional label to override the default name for the Banner landmark region

props.name: className
props.description: Provide an optional className to add to the outermost element rendered by the Banner

props.name: description
props.description: Provide an optional description for the Banner. This should provide supplemental information about the Banner

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Whether to hide the title visually.

props.name: icon
props.description: Provide a custom icon for the Banner. This is only available when `variant` is `info` or `upsell`

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Provide a custom leading visual for the Banner. This is only available when `variant` is `info` or `upsell`

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Optionally provide a handler to be called when the banner is dismissed. Providing this prop will show a dismiss button

props.name: title
props.description: The title for the Banner. This will be used as the accessible name and is required unless `Banner.Title` is used as a child

props.name: variant
props.description: Specify the type of the Banner

props.name: layout
props.description: Specify the layout of the Banner. Compact layout will reduce the padding.

props.name: actionsLayout
props.description: Override the responsive layout of the action buttons. 'inline' layout will display the buttons inline with the title and description, while 'stacked' layout will always render the buttons in a new row.

props.name: flush
props.description: Full width banner specifically for use within confined spaces, such as dialogs, tables, cards, or boxes where available space is limited.
